faults.fault: At 2x width the screen stretched into one enormously wide panel instead of staying a single CRT-sized screen in the centre — a stretched screen, not a wider cabinet
At 1.5x height the lower panel gained duplicated stacked door/vent boxes instead of simply being a longer plain panel — reads as repeated coin doors, a bug not a decision

At 1.5x height a smeared, streaked blank band appears between the speaker shelf and the screen where the extra cabinet height should be plain carcass; side 'SPACE WARP' art is mirrored and garbled ('WAKY') where the panel stretched

wider_means: A wider arcade cabinet is a two-player cabinet -- a second joystick and button cluster on the shared control deck.
taller_means: A taller arcade cabinet is a taller cabinet body -- more plain carcass below the control deck and a longer lower panel, not a taller screen or marquee.
